name: Steam Launcher
author: Alan
description: An always-visible Steam icon for the bar. Left-click opens a quick-launcher popup for your installed games, with box art and a blurb pulled from Steam's free endpoints, sorted by last-played, plus a collapsed list of everything else you own with one-click Install buttons. One click launches a game. Right-click still gives Steam's own native menu (Store, Library, Friends, Settings, Exit).

barWidget.description: Steam icon + quick-launcher popup for installed games
